name: Razorfen Kraul (Classic)
summary: In the southern Barrens, Razorfen Kraul is the quilboar's ancestral heartland. The crone Charlga Razorflank rules its thorn-walled maze, from which her warriors strike across the region.

sections.title: Blood of the Boar God
sections.body:
Ten thousand years ago, Agamaggan gave his life against the Burning Legion to save Azeroth. The colossal boar demigod's blood fell across southern Kalimdor. From each place it touched the soil, colossal thorn vines rose, thick and impenetrable.

The quilboar believe they are the Great Boar's mortal descendants. They gathered among the briars to dwell and honor his sacrifice. Razorfen Kraul is their most revered stronghold, home to warriors, beast trainers, and shamans who shape the earth.

sections.title: The Crone's Ambition
sections.body:
Reports from watchful scouts speak of undead figures lurking among the thorny briars. Charlga Razorflank, the aging geomancer who rules the Kraul, has led the Razorfen tribe in merciless raids against rival quilboar bands and nearby Horde encampments.

Whispers say Charlga has begun bargaining with agents of the Scourge. Should she bring undeath to the quilboar, the danger would reach beyond the Barrens.

faq.q: What created the giant thorns around Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Legend says the colossal thorn vines sprang from the soil wherever Agamaggan's blood fell during the War of the Ancients, ten thousand years ago.
Charlga Razorflank, a ruthless quilboar crone and geomancer, rules Razorfen Kraul. She directs raids against neighboring tribes and settlements.

faq.q: Why are there undead near the Kraul?
faq.answer: Reports say Charlga Razorflank has begun secret negotiations with agents of the Scourge. Their bargain could bring undeath among the quilboar.
Razorfen Kraul lies in the southern Barrens, on the western side of the colossal thorn thickets just north of the Great Lift.

angles.text: Charlga Razorflank's raids threaten southern settlements and trade routes. The Horde needs to secure the region by pacifying the Kraul.
As a Tauren, you share a deep historical enmity with the quilboar. Rumors of Scourge corruption in Agamaggan's revered earth call for swift action.
